This plot is small and I rent it, so I cannot spend too much, but here in Kilimanjaro the rains come twice and maize does well if I care for it properly. I will try to buy one bag of CAN for top-dressing and carry some manure from my neighbor's boma to mix in at planting. I will buy improved maize seed from the agrodealer in town since I have learned that good seed repays itself, but pesticides and irrigation are not for me — I weed with my hoe and wait for the rains. My daughter-in-law will help me at weeding time, and I may pay one young man for a few days when the work is heavy.
